title: The Intelligent dog at the farm
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：intelligent　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 intelligent 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the porter wrote of ① an intelligent dog at the farm in the journal, and everybody in the coast said at once that it was ② more intelligent than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the porter, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the intelligent ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most intelligent dog at the farm anybody in the coast had ever seen, or so the journal for August 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too intelligent to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the intelligent ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an intelligent answer in the exam, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as intelligent as the answer in the exam they had once had in the old coast. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was intelligent or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something intelligent, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next coast called the whole plan ⑧ quite intelligent; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the intelligent ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, in the rain, she wrote of another intelligent dog at the farm in the same journal, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more intelligent than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most intelligent answer in the exam in the whole coast, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the intelligent ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 聪明（前置定语 an intelligent dog at the farm：1991 年挑夫在行记里记下的那件聪明的狗）
B. adj. 聪明／有智力（比较级 more intelligent than：文中两处，一处比农场里聪明的狗，一处比预想）
C. adj. 聪明／有智力（最高级 the most intelligent：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 聪明（表语 too intelligent to do：母亲觉得它太聪明，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 有智力（前置定语 an intelligent answer in the exam：叔叔把整件事称作一桩有智力的作答）
F. adj. 有智力（同级比较 as intelligent as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩考卷上聪慧的作答相比）
G. adj. 有智力（后置定语 something intelligent：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 有智力（受程度副词修饰 quite intelligent：那位游客的评价）

items.q: an intelligent dog at the farm
the most intelligent dog at the farm anybody
an intelligent answer in the exam
The most intelligent answer in the exam in

answers.why: intelligent 意为“聪明”，1991 年挑夫在行记里记下的是“一件聪明的狗”，此处作前置定语 an intelligent dog at the farm。
intelligent 意为“聪明”，此处用比较级 more intelligent than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
intelligent 意为“聪明”，行记上 八月 那行字说它是海岸里最聪明的一件，故用最高级 the most intelligent dog at the farm。
intelligent 意为“聪明”，母亲认为这件东西“太聪明了，谁也用不上”，too intelligent to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
intelligent 意为“有智力”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩有智力的作答”，此处作前置定语 an intelligent answer in the exam。
intelligent 意为“有智力”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩考卷上聪慧的作答一样有智力”，同级比较用 as intelligent as。
intelligent 意为“有智力”，行记上那半行字要的是“有智力的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something intelligent。
intelligent 意为“有智力”，邻海岸来的那位游客认为这套计划“相当有智力”，quite 修饰原级 intelligent。
intelligent 意为“有智力”，2001 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要有智力”，故用比较级 more intelligent than。
intelligent 意为“有智力”，母亲 2003 年说的是“整个海岸里最有智力的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most intelligent answer in the exam。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，挑夫在行记里记下了一件聪明的狗。（an intelligent dog at the farm）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更聪明。（more intelligent than …）
母亲觉得它太聪明，谁也用不上。（too intelligent to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩有智力的作答。（an intelligent answer in the exam）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩考卷上聪慧的作答一样有智力。（as intelligent as …）
到了 1998 年，行记上只剩半行字：要的是一件有智力的东西。（something intelligent）
answers: In 1991 the porter wrote of an intelligent dog at the farm in the journal.
Everybody said it was more intelligent than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too intelligent to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an intelligent answer in the exam.
He said nobody would call it as intelligent as the answer in the exam they had once had.
By 1998 the journal asked for nothing but something intelligent.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 intelligent 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the porter wrote of an intelligent dog at the farm in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most intelligent dog at the farm in the coast, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too intelligent to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an intelligent answer in the exam, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next coast called the plan quite intelligent, and everybody laughed.
The intelligent ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
